title: Light Etcher
body:
"This axe is wielded by only the strongest darklings, its purpose is to eradicate light by absorbing it into the axe itself. Stronger against Heavenly Trees"

Description

Not to be confused with the Shadow Etcher, the Light Etcher is a black and white axe rarely dropped from Light Axe Darklings in The Void. It has the special ability of doing considerably more damage to the rarely spawning Heavenly Tree.

Like the Shadow Etcher, the Light Etcher also has a drop rate of 2%, though the lower spawn rate of Light Axe Darklings can make obtaining the axe particularly challenging.

Ability


When hitting a tree there is a roughly 50% chance of the Light etchers ability to activate, this ability summons a large white etcher formed of light making a loud chopping sound and deals a considerable amount of damage to the log.
